# SYNESIS_E149 — Error

## Description

`concept_a` -> `parent_concept` collapses after USE (parent of itself).

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
`concept_a` has `parent_concept` in `field_name`, but `parent_concept` uses
  `concept_a`: after consolidation, the concept would be its own parent.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **HierarchyCollapsedByUse**: `concept`, `field_name`, `parent`
